CC 2.1.278 + 2.1.280 and Opus 5.5 adoption

latest_known 2.1.277 to 2.1.280, floor unchanged at 2.1.277, 2.1.279 never published. Sources: upstream CHANGELOG lines quoted per row, the claude-api skill model table, the auto-mode classifier billing doc.

01 / What Opus 5.5 costs, and what ork reported before this PR

Rates per MTok: Opus 5.5 $4 / $20 / $0.20 read (CHANGELOG 2.1.280). Opus 5 $5 / $25 / $0.50. Sonnet 5 fallback $2 / $10 / $0.20: before this PR, getPricing('claude-opus-5-5') matched no row and took that fallback.

02 / The gate that could not see the advance

superseded(token):                       alias target = claude-opus-5-5
  before  return not cur.startswith(token + "-")
          "claude-opus-5-5".startswith("claude-opus-5-")   -> True  -> "same model", exempt
  after   return not DATE_SNAPSHOT_RE.fullmatch(cur[len(token):])
          "-5"        is not -YYYYMMDD                     -> reported as superseded
          "-20251001" (claude-haiku-4-5)                   -> still exempt
Before the fix the gate printed "opus=claude-opus-5-5" as the current target and still reported 0 superseded recommendations. After: 5 ID recommendations and 19 prose claims surfaced and were retargeted; baseline prose_claims fell 11 to 1. tests/skills/structure/test-model-recency-snapshot-exemption.sh is red on the old scanner and green on the new one.
